restrained.said: The tools we pay most for are the ones nobody adopts.
Each dot is one entity, placed at its two measures.
Atlas: Annual cost, four hundred twenty thousand dollars; Teams adopting, eighteen percent.
Renewal lands in March. Two teams asked to drop it.
Borealis: Annual cost, three hundred ten thousand dollars; Teams adopting, twenty-four percent.
Cardinal: Annual cost, one hundred eighty thousand dollars; Teams adopting, fifty-two percent.
Dovetail: Annual cost, ninety-five thousand dollars; Teams adopting, sixty-one percent.
Everline: Annual cost, two hundred forty thousand dollars; Teams adopting, thirty-one percent.
Fathom: Annual cost, sixty thousand dollars; Teams adopting, seventy-four percent.
